name: Radha's Indian Restaurant (Bole)
description: Radha's Indian Restaurant and Bar offers authentic Indian cuisine in a sophisticated and welcoming setting. We are proud to feature a chef's team we brought directly from the finest kitchens in India and Dubai.Our extensive menu features classic tandoori specialties, biryanis, and a wide variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian curries, all made with traditional spices and fresh ingredients. Our full bar serves signature cocktails, Indian-inspired drinks, beer, and wine. Perfect for date nights, family gatherings, and special events. We offer dine-in, takeaway, and catering services.

menu.name: Samosa (2 Pices)
menu.description: crispy golden pastry filled with spiced potatoes and peas-savory, flaky, and bursting with flavor in every bite

menu.name: Mix Veg Pakoda
menu.description: fresh vegetables dipped in spiced gram flour batter and deep fried-crispy, colorful, and bursting with bold flavor

menu.name: Hara Bhara Kebab
menu.description: wholesome patties made from spinach, green peas, potatoes, and aromatic spices-vibrant green, mildly spiced and pan seared

menu.name: Paneer Tikka
menu.description: boldly spiced paneer infused with yogurt and grilled over flames-smoky, savory

menu.name: Jodhpuri Kebab
menu.description: vegetable kebab blended with paneer, spices, and dry fruits crispy on the outside, soft within, and layered with the rajasthani

menu.name: Chilli Paneer (Dry/Gravy)
menu.description: paneer cubes stir fried with bell peppers, garlic, green chilies, and soy-based sauce fiery, tangy, and packed with indo chinese flair. choose dry for a crisp, bold bite or gravy for a rich, saucy indulgence

menu.name: Tandoori Chicken
menu.description: chicken marinated in yogurt, mustard oil, bold indian spices grilled in the tandoor for smoky char and juicy tenderness finished with lemon, butterand chaat masala

menu.name: Chicken Tikka
menu.description: tender boneless chicken marinated in a blend of spiced yogurt, garlic, and ginger, then grilled over open flame for layers of smoky, charred flavor with a soft, succulent interior

menu.name: Chilli Chicken
menu.description: crispy chicken tossed with garlic, green chilies, and bell peppers in a spicy soy-based sauce-bold, tangy, and deeply satisfying, whether served sizzling dry or immersed in rich gravy

menu.name: Chicken Lollypop (6 Pieces)
menu.description: frenched chicken wings marinated in bold spices, deep fried to a crisp golden finish, and served with a spicy-tangy sauce crunchy on the outside

menu.name: Shahi Paneer
menu.description: soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, creamy gravy of cashews, cream, and aromatic spices

menu.name: Kadhai Paneer
menu.description: soft paneer cubes simmered in bold indian gravies choose the smoky warmth of spiced tomato and bell pepper, or the creamy richness of pureed spinach and aromatic herbs. each dish offers a distinct yet comforting taste

menu.name: Mix Vegetables
menu.description: a medley of seasonal veggies sauteed with onions, tomatoes, and warm spices colorful, hearty, and full of home style flavor in every bite

menu.name: Alu Gobhi Masala
menu.description: cauliflower and potatoes sauteed with onion, tomatoes, and traditional spices warm and rustic

menu.name: Veg Kolhapuri
menu.description: a fiery medley of mixed vegetables simmered in a bold, spicy kolhapuri masala rich in roasted spices, vibrant in color, and brimming with maharashtrian heat and flavor

menu.name: Veg Jalfrez
menu.description: a vibrant stir fry of mixed vegetables, bell peppers, and onions tossed in a tangy tomato based masala bold, colorful, and full of liverly spice

menu.name: Butter Chicken
menu.description: button mushrooms stir fried with bell peppers, onions, and a bold blend of kadhai spices smoky, robust, and bursting

menu.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
menu.description: tender chicken simmered in a creamy yogurt based gravy infused with freshly crushed black pepper, garlic, and whole spices bold, peppery, and luxuriously aromatic with every bite.

menu.name: Chicken Kolhapuri
menu.description: a fiery maharashtrian delicacy of chicken simmered in a bold, aromatic gravy made with roasted spices, coconut, sesame, and poppy seeds intensely spiced smoky, and bursting with rustic kolhapuri heat

menu.description: fresh fish simmered in bold indian gravies choose comforting,soupy richness of traditional curry or the robust, spiced intensity of masala style, both offer coastal warmth with tomato, onion, and aromatic spices, perfect with rice or naan
